_about: Frameflow scene catalog for the shorts-director skill. Templates live in scenes/<name>/scene.html; validation in frameflow/scene_plan.py.

street.about: A drawn street of 2-6 buildings (websites, shops, offices) that share something. Great for 'many things depend on one thing', shutdowns, scanning, a race. Camera can pan down to a shared foundation.

data.buildings: 2-6 of {label (<=14 chars, CAPS reads best), kind: house|shop|tower|school|gov|news|bank}
data.robotLabel: tag on the robot (e.g. AI, LOCKSMITH); set it per scene

verbs.note: {text (<=22 chars), until?: cue}: big handwritten line in the sky with a red underline
verbs.lights-off: {order?: [indexes], stagger?}: windows go dark one by one
verbs.locks: {stagger?}: the same padlock pops onto every door
verbs.foundation: camera pans down to reveal the shared slab + label
verbs.crack: a crack runs through the slab, buildings shake
verbs.robot: {per?: seconds per door}: a robot walks the street rattling every door handle
verbs.shutters: {stagger?}: rolling shutters slam down with a stamp
verbs.race: {door?: index, labels: [left, right], run?: seconds}: two figures race to one door; a red ? lands
verbs.zoom: {index, scale?}: camera pushes into one building

flow.about: How something works: 2-3 drawn nodes (boxes with icons) with things travelling between them. Great for request/response, a hijack, a pipeline.

verbs.send: {from?: 0, to?: 1, token: label}: an envelope travels on an arc above
verbs.return: {from?: 1, to?: 0, token}: a yellow envelope travels back below
verbs.hijack: {token, result: terminal text (\n for new line)}: a back door on the target swings open, a red envelope arrives, the node turns red, a terminal types the result
verbs.note: {text, y?: pixels or 0-1 fraction of the frame height (kept below the kicker)}

stack.about: Isometric 2.5D layers (a tech stack, a layer cake) that build, lift apart, highlight the culprit and get stamped.

data.layers: 2-6 of {label (<=22), hot?: true}; item 0 is the top

verbs.build: layers drop in from the bottom up
verbs.highlight: the hot layer slides out and shakes, the rest dim
verbs.stamp: a stamp slams onto the hot layer

meter.about: An escalation: a drawn thermometer fills step by step while each step's words slam in and alert cards pile up behind.

verbs.step: {i}: the meter rises to this step, its words slam, more cards pile up

flap.about: A split-flap board rolling from one number (a year) to another, then a caption, then an optional birthday cake with one candle per unit. Great for 'how old', dates, countdowns.

data.caption: <=22 chars
data.sub: small handwritten line under the caption

verbs.caption: {text?}: the caption slams in
verbs.cake: {candles?}: a drawn cake with candles pops in

kinetic.about: Words as the picture: 1-5 lines entering on their own cues, each in a style. For hooks, twists, punchlines. Optional sunburst background.

data.lines: 1-5 of {t (<=24 chars), style: slam|drop|scramble|type|stamp|marker|strike, color?: red|blue|muted, font?: hand|mono, size?}

verbs.line: {i}: line i enters in its style
verbs.circle: {i}: a red hand-drawn ellipse circles line i

stamps.about: Index cards (names) that each get a rubber stamp (OFFLINE, PATCHED, BANNED...). For lists of things affected.

verbs.stamp: {i?: one card, stagger?}: stamps land (all in turn when no i)

quote.about: A real quote revealed word by word, one phrase swiped with a highlighter, who said it, and a doodle (fire, bulb, lock, bug).

data.mark: phrase from the quote to highlight

chat.about: A hand-drawn chat with an AI: the prompt types, the model thinks, the reply types, a stamp lands. The reply is a re-enactment unless quoted from a source, so data.note must say so.

data.title: window title
data.note: required when the reply is invented, e.g. 're-enactment'

news-snapshot.about: A real screenshot of the source article with the key phrase highlighted. Use once for credibility.

cast.about: 1-3 drawn people (Open Peeps, CC0: student, friend, techie, uncle, auntie, neighbour, elder) who react to the story with speech bubbles, face changes, a ring, an arrow with a label. For the human side: who is affected, what an ordinary person says or feels, before/after reactions.

data.people: 1-3 of {who: student|friend|techie|uncle|auntie|neighbour|elder, face?: smile|explaining|concerned|awe|suspicious|serious|fear|smileLOL (start face), label?: name tag (<=16)}

verbs.enter: {stagger?}: the people bounce in and the ground line draws
verbs.face: {i, face}: person i changes expression (same face list)
verbs.say: {i, text (<=40), until?}: a drawn speech bubble pops above person i
verbs.circle: {i}: a red ring is drawn around person i
verbs.arrow: {i, text (<=24)}: a red label with a drawn arrow pointing at person i
verbs.note: {text (<=24), until?}: a big handwritten line with an underline at the top
